g.text: Fixed core–shell morphology and orientation: illumination controls
Outer side 52 nm; core contrast excess 0.5; morphology roll 25°. Beam-boundary orientation changes independently.
Rows use their own uniform q=0 reference; compare illumination within each row. No probe-phase variation, noise or liquid-jet model.
